overview_description.description:
Routine is a work operating system that helps individuals and teams organize and manage their work efficiently.

Routine centralizes work (tasks, meetings, tickets, clients etc.) from third-party services (Github, Salesforce, Hubspot, Slack, Dropbox etc.) into a graph-based unified workspace allowing seamless cross-referencing, 360-degree overview, data enrichment and visualization.

By integrating with existing tools, Routine connects and enriches fragmented information, allowing users to track projects, collaborate efficiently, and make better decisions without having to constantly switch between multiple apps.

Its data-driven and local-first approach ensures the information remains accessible and performant even without cloud connectivity.

product.name: Routine Work Operating System
product.description: An all-in-one work platform that centralizes tasks, notes, meetings, calendars, contacts, and projects into a unified workspace for individuals and teams.

product.name: Routine Integrations
product.description: Connects Routine with over 200 third-party services to synchronize calendars, tasks, contacts, and other work-related data.

product.name: Routine Planner
product.description: A planner-based calendar tool within Routine to help users plan, prioritize, and schedule their work effectively.

product.name: Routine Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard interface for quick capture and management of tasks, notes, and ideas on the go, available via Routine’s mobile apps.

product.name: Routine AI Features
product.description: AI-powered tools within Routine that assist with task creation, content summarization, and smart suggestions to enhance productivity.

product.name: Routine Custom Types and Views
product.description: Allows users to define custom data relations and visualize information through tailored views to support better decision-making.
